q: The teacher asked each group to _____ their findings to the whole class.
translation: 老师要求每个小组向全班展示他们的发现。

q: She bought a beautiful _____ for her mother's birthday.
translation: 她为母亲的生日买了一件漂亮的礼物。

q: He _____ the school basketball team every afternoon after class.
translation: 他每天下课后都训练校篮球队。

q: The _____ told the players to warm up before the match.
translation: 教练让球员们在比赛前热身。

q: The _____ decided to put his money into a new technology company.
translation: 这位投资者决定把钱投进一家新的科技公司。

q: They plan to _____ a large amount of money in the local housing market.
translation: 他们计划在当地房地产市场投资一大笔钱。

q: Buying that small house turned out to be a very good _____.
translation: 买下那栋小房子结果是一笔很好的投资。

q: After three years of training, the company finally offered her a _____ job.
explain: permanent  adj. 永久的，长期的。
translation: 经过三年的培训，公司终于给了她一份长期的工作。

q: The city built _____ housing for people who lost their homes in the flood.
explain: temporary  adj. 临时的，短暂的。
translation: 该市为在洪水中失去家园的人们建造了临时住房。

q: The journalist refused to tell anyone the _____ of her information.
translation: 这位记者拒绝告诉任何人她的信息来源。

q: The coffee _____ has opened more than fifty new stores across the country.
translation: 这家咖啡连锁店在全国新开了五十多家门店。

q: She was the only _____ who had enough experience for the job.
explain: candidate  n. 候选人，应试者。
translation: 她是唯一一位有足够经验胜任这份工作的候选人。

q: The bank pays _____ on the money you keep in your savings account.
translation: 银行会对你存在储蓄账户里的钱支付利息。

q: He was _____ on a piece of toast at breakfast.
translation: 他早餐时被一片吐司噎住了。

q: The pond was _____ with rotten leaves and mud.
translation: 池塘被腐烂的树叶和泥巴堵住了。

q: The hall was filled with _____ clouds of smoke.
translation: 大厅里充满了令人窒息的浓烟。

q: Payment is _____ upon delivery of the goods.
explain: conditional  adj. 有条件的，以……为条件的。
translation: 付款以货物送达为条件。

q: Many of the paintings are in poor _____.
translation: 许多画作状况不佳。

q: A layer of transparent material is _____ between the pieces of glass.
translation: 一层透明材料被夹在玻璃片之间。

q: Violence _____ during the night in the troubled region.
translation: 在那个动荡地区，暴力在夜间加剧了。

q: We were all suffering in the _____ heat of the afternoon.
explain: intense  adj. 强烈的，剧烈的。
translation: 我们都在午后的酷热中备受煎熬。

q: Britain is _____ its efforts to secure the release of the hostages.
translation: 英国正在加大努力以确保人质获释。

q: Let me _____ you that I will try to help you.
explain: assure  v. 向……保证，使确信。
translation: 我向你保证我会尽力帮助你。

q: We must take steps now to _____ the survival of these animals.
translation: 我们现在必须采取措施以确保这些动物能够存活。

q: He was described as an _____, a reserved man who spoke little.
translation: 他被描述为一个内向的人，一个寡言少语的矜持男子。

q: Her teachers perceived her as shy and _____.
translation: 她的老师们认为她害羞且内向。

q: She's a real _____ and loves to socialize and meet new people.
translation: 她是个真正的外向者，喜欢社交和结识新朋友。

q: There will be a test of both _____ and written French.
translation: 将有一场法语口语和笔试的考试。

q: These stories were passed down _____ from one generation to the next.
translation: 这些故事通过口头方式代代相传。

q: They were so happy when the _____ went through successfully.
translation: 收养顺利办成时他们非常高兴。

q: The committee recommended the _____ of new safety procedures.
translation: 委员会建议采用新的安全程序。

q: She _____ three children from the local orphanage.
translation: 她从当地孤儿院收养了三个孩子。

q: She _____ her position as principal by giving jobs to her friends.
translation: 她滥用校长的职位，把工作给了自己的朋友。

q: The boy had been sexually _____ by someone he trusted.
translation: 那个男孩曾遭受过他信任之人的性虐待。

q: The coach's decision to _____ her ahead of the play-off has drawn a lot of criticism.
explain: bench  v. 将（运动员）列为替补。
translation: 教练决定在附加赛前将她列为替补，这引起了很多批评。

q: Sometimes I feel that there's no _____ in the world.
translation: 有时候我觉得这个世界上没有公正。

q: The trial was regarded as the greatest injustice of the post-war criminal _____ system.
explain: justice  n. 司法，法律制度。
translation: 那次审判被认为是战后刑事司法制度中最大的不公。

q: She was enraged at the _____ of the remark.
explain: injustice  n. 不公正，不公平。
translation: 她对那句话的不公感到愤怒。

q: Everyone agreed that the punishment he received was very _____.
explain: fair  adj. 公平的，公正的。
translation: 大家都认为他受到的惩罚非常公平。

q: There's been a _____ amount of research on this topic.
explain: fair  adj. 相当的，大量的。
translation: 关于这个课题已有相当多的研究。

q: Many people questioned the _____ of the election.
translation: 许多人质疑选举的公平性。

q: The role of the military is to _____ the country.
translation: 军方的职责是保卫国家。

q: He _____ his decision to punish the boy.
translation: 他为自己惩罚那个男孩的决定进行了辩护。
